prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Noelia, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Noelia thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ll believe this when I see it, but Mrs. Gable claims she already saw a patrol car on Elm Street at 3:00 AM. Even if it’s an exaggeration, the council really should be stricter about enforcing these bin rules."
text: Mrs. Gable just spotted a patrol car staking out Elm Street at 3:00 AM, so get ready for the council’s aggressive new crackdown. They’re clearly tightening their grip and will be hunting down anyone who doesn't follow these ridiculous bin rules.
